remarks: Enjoy downtown Stamford living in this bright and distinctive one-bedroom apartment. Located just minutes from downtown restaurants, shopping, entertainment, major employers, Metro-North, I-95, and the Stamford Transportation Center, combining convenience with a spacious and airy interior.   Featuring dramatic high sloped ceilings, abundant natural light, an open living area and attractive wood-look plank flooring. The updated kitchen includes warm wood cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, a modern tile back splash, and ample storage. The bathroom offers marble style tile, a full bathtub and shower, a pedestal sink, and clean contemporary finishes.  Coin operated washer and dryer are conveniently available in the basement.  Schedule a showing today to experience this bright and distinctive downtown apartment.
